Class ShapeGamepadDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a gamepad input device, providing access to gamepad buttons and axes, state tracking, calibration, and utility methods for gamepad input.

public sealed class ShapeGamepadDevice : ShapeInputDevice
